R8500.summary: A clear holograph despatch from Stafford in Paris about Captain Blaize, Locatello, Cambrai and a book printed at Rome by Dr Sanders; the five ciphered runs of the postscript say that Junius' son came from Cambrai with letters, about papers of his credit with Balagny (governor of Cambrai), and Stafford's fear that Balagny means them some mischief. Key rebuilt from the glossed and deciphered sibling letters in the same volume.

system: Letter substitution with homophones (6=e, w=a, x=i/y ...) plus single-sign and numeric codes (B Villeroy, O+ Nemours, 120 French ambassador, 47 King of Navarre).
